text:
marta.lopez: Heads-up: publishing the "On-Prem Telemetry & Migration Play" for Private customers today. This includes opt-in toggle language, SOW snippets, and a PS-run migration checklist.

ronin.ops: Nice. Quick Q: will the toggle be enforced at the platform layer or just advisory in the SOW?

marta.lopez: Platform-layer guardrail + SOW clause. Platform flag will prevent persistent writes outside chosen region. SOW clause named SOW-TP-1.0.

docsbuilder-bot: New draft published: /kb/onprem-telemetry-migration-play (internal preview). Reviewers: @ronin.ops @legal-sig.

legal-sig: Reviewed the SOW snippet. Added explicit customer consent language and a rollback acceptance window (48 hours). Please don't ship customer-facing copy without legal signoff.

amy.sales: For AE enablement: can we get a 1-slide summary and a 2-paragraph email blurb? customers will ask about downtime and billing.

marta.lopez: Yes — working with docs to deliver a one-slide summary + email blurb by EOD tomorrow. Migration plan highlights: snapshot export -> customer-controlled import -> validation in staging. No forced cutover.

ronin.ops: Ops note: add verification step for NTP <500ms skew and block enabling encryption-with-swap if encrypted-swap=true; we had a case where metadata leaked.

marta.lopez: Adding verification step and a note about disabling encrypted swap. Good catch.

legal-sig: Also require CKMS (customer KMS) policy sample for key residency. I'll attach a short example in the KB.

docsbuilder-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Telemetry & Migration doc review" at 1805007000 for @ronin.ops @legal-sig.

amy.sales: Ping once the slide is ready; I'll schedule a quick AE drop-in to walk through objections.

marta.lopez: Final note: telemetry is optional and billable only if customer opts in to performance telemetry. We'll include clear opt-in/out steps in the KB. Merging draft to v1.0 at 1805007000 unless blockers.

ronin.ops: Reviewed from ops POV; no blockers.

legal-sig: Legal signoff pending minor wording tweak.

docsbuilder-bot: Draft v0.9 published at 1805006789. Planned v1.0 merge at 1805007000.
